title: Surveys and Questionnaires — Design, Sampling and Response Bias

hook.en: Anyone can make a survey in ten minutes. Making one that gives a true answer takes more care. A leading question, a convenience sample or a 15 percent response rate can quietly make a survey say whatever you hoped it would.
hook.ur: Koi bhi das minute mein survey bana sakta hai. Aisa banana jo sachcha jawab de, zyada ehtiyat maangta hai. Rehnumai karne wala sawal, aasaani se mila sample ya 15 fisad response rate chupke se survey ko woh kehne par majboor kar sakte hain jo aap chahte thay.

goal.en: By the end, you'll write clear, neutral questions, choose a sensible sampling approach, spot response and non-response bias, and test a questionnaire before sending it.
goal.ur: End tak aap saaf, ghair jaanibdaar sawal likhenge, munasib sampling ka tareeqa chunenge, response aur non-response bias pehchanenge, aur bhejne se pehle questionnaire ko test karenge.

text.en: A **survey** collects data from a **sample** in order to describe a **population**. Three things decide its worth: **who** you ask (sampling), **how** you ask (question wording and mode) and **who answers** (response rate). A random sample from a complete list allows generalisation; a convenience sample (whoever is easy) shows only what those people said. A low response rate can make the results unreliable, because people who answer often differ from those who do not.
text.ur: **Survey** ek **sample** se data jama karta hai taake ek **aabadi** ko bayan kare. Teen cheezein is ki qeemat tay karti hain: aap **kis** se poochhte hain (sampling), **kaise** poochhte hain (sawal ke alfaaz aur tareeqa) aur **kaun jawab deta hai** (response rate). Mukammal list se random sample generalisation ki ijazat deta hai; convenience sample (jo aasaan ho) sirf un logon ki raaye dikhata hai. Kam response rate nateejon ko na-qabil-e-aitbaar bana sakta hai, kyunke jawab dene wale aksar na dene walon se mukhtalif hote hain.

text.en: Think of **tasting a pot of soup**. You stir it well, then take one spoonful, and that spoonful tells you about the whole pot. If you skip stirring and taste only the top, you learn about the top only. A survey sample needs the "stirring" of random selection.
text.ur: **Deg ka shorba chakhna** sochein. Aap achhi tarah hilate hain, phir ek chamcha lete hain, aur woh poori deg ke baare mein batata hai. Agar na hilayein aur sirf oopar se chakhein to sirf oopar ke baare mein pata chalta hai. Survey sample ko random intikhab ki "hilai" chahiye.

title.ur: Survey ke aam masail aur hal

rows.en: Use neutral words: "How would you rate the service?"
rows.ur: Ghair jaanibdaar alfaaz: "Aap service ko kaise rate karenge?"

rows.en: Ask one thing at a time
rows.ur: Ek waqt mein ek cheez poochhein

rows.en: Only patients in the waiting room today
rows.ur: Sirf aaj intezar gaah ke mareez

rows.en: Say so openly, or sample across days and times
rows.ur: Saaf batayein, ya mukhtalif dinon aur waqton mein sample lein

rows.en: Only 20 percent reply, mostly very happy or very unhappy
rows.ur: Sirf 20 fisad jawab dete hain, zyada tar bohat khush ya bohat na-khush

rows.en: Follow up, shorten the survey, report the response rate
rows.ur: Follow up karein, survey chhota karein, response rate batayein

rows.en: People overreport exercise and underreport pain
rows.ur: Log exercise zyada aur dard kam batate hain

question.en: Which question is best for a patient satisfaction survey?
question.ur: Mareez ki itminaan ke survey ke liye kaun sa sawal behtareen hai?

text.en: "Was the therapist friendly and the clinic cheap?"
text.ur: "Kya therapist dostana aur clinic sasta tha?"

text.en: "How would you rate the time the therapist spent with you?" with a scale from very poor to very good
text.ur: "Therapist ne aap ko jo waqt diya use aap kaise rate karenge?" bahut kharab se bahut achha tak scale ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — it is neutral, single-topic and has a clear scale.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh ghair jaanibdaar, ek mauzu ka hai aur saaf scale rakhta hai.

text.en: "Don't you agree our caring therapists gave you enough time?"
text.ur: "Kya aap mutafiq nahi ke hamare shafeeq therapists ne aap ko kaafi waqt diya?"

feedback.ur: Yeh jawab ki taraf le jata hai.

question.en: A clinic emails a survey to 500 past patients and 60 reply. What is the main concern?
question.ur: Ek clinic 500 purane mareezon ko survey email karta hai aur 60 jawab dete hain. Sab se badi fikr kya hai?

text.en: There is no concern if answers look positive
text.ur: Koi fikr nahi agar jawab musbat lagen

feedback.en: Positive answers may come from happy people only.
feedback.ur: Musbat jawab sirf khush logon se aa sakte hain.

text.en: A 12 percent response rate risks non-response bias, since those who reply may differ from those who do not
text.ur: 12 fisad response rate se non-response bias ka khatra hai, kyunke jawab dene walay na dene walon se mukhtalif ho sakte hain

feedback.en: Yes — low response limits how far the results can be trusted.
feedback.ur: Haan — kam response nateejon par bharosa ki had tay karta hai.
Chhote surveys aam taur par response mein madad dete hain.

question.en: What should you do before sending a new questionnaire widely?
question.ur: Naya questionnaire wasi pemane par bhejne se pehle kya karna chahiye?

text.en: Add more questions to be thorough
text.ur: Mukammal hone ke liye mazeed sawal jorein

feedback.ur: Lambay surveys response kam karte hain.

text.en: Send it to everyone and fix it later
text.ur: Sab ko bhej dein aur baad mein theek karein

feedback.en: Mistakes cannot be fixed after sending.
feedback.ur: Bhejne ke baad ghaltiyan theek nahi hoti.

text.en: Pilot it with a few people, ask what each question meant to them, and fix confusing items
text.ur: Chand logon par pilot karein, poochhein har sawal ka kya matlab liya, aur uljhane wale items theek karein

feedback.ur: Haan — pilot masail sasti qeemat par dhoondhta hai.

text.en: **Asking only the people who are easiest to reach.** Surveying only patients who come back misses those who dropped out, often the ones with the most to say. Also, do not use a questionnaire in another language or culture without translation and testing: a direct translation may not mean the same thing. Report who was invited, who answered and how many.
text.ur: **Sirf un logon se poochhna jo aasani se mil jayein.** Sirf wapas aane wale mareezon ka survey un ko chhor deta hai jinhon ne chhora, jo aksar sab se zyada kehne ko rakhte hain. Aur kisi doosri zubaan ya saqafat mein questionnaire tarjuma aur test ke baghair istemal na karein: seedha tarjuma wohi matlab nahi rakhta. Report karein ke kise dawat di gayi, kis ne jawab diya aur kitne.

text.en: **Keep it short and useful.** A patient survey with five questions and one open comment box is more likely to be filled than a long form. Use the answers: tell patients what changed because of their feedback, and they will answer next time. In Pakistan, offer the survey in Urdu, and read it aloud for patients who cannot read comfortably.
text.ur: **Chhota aur mufeed rakhein.** Paanch sawalon aur ek khule comment box wala mareez survey lambe form se zyada bhara jata hai. Jawabon ko istemal karein: mareezon ko batayein unki raaye se kya badla, aur woh agli baar jawab dein ge. Pakistan mein survey Urdu mein dein, aur un mareezon ke liye zor se parh kar sunayein jo aaram se parh nahi sakte.

question.en: Is a big sample always better than a small one?
question.ur: Kya bara sample hamesha chhote se behtar hai?

answer.en: Not if it is a biased sample. A convenience sample of 10,000 can be less trustworthy than a random sample of 400. Size reduces random error, but it does nothing for bias in who was asked, how they were asked or who answered. Get the sampling and response right first, then think about size.
answer.ur: Nahi agar sample biased ho. 10,000 ka convenience sample 400 ke random sample se kam bharosemand ho sakta hai. Size random ghalti kam karta hai, lekin us bias par koi asar nahi daalta jo is mein ho ke kis se poochha, kaise poochha ya kis ne jawab diya. Pehle sampling aur response theek karein, phir size ke baare mein sochein.

beats.patient: A student wants to know how many physiotherapists in Karachi have work-related back pain. She posts a link in a WhatsApp group and gets 150 replies, 70 percent reporting pain.
beats.assessment: Those who reply to a back-pain survey may be those who have back pain, so the figure may be too high, and the group does not represent all Karachi therapists.
beats.treatment: She is clear that this is a convenience sample, keeps her wording neutral, pilots the questionnaire, and describes the results as "among respondents", not "among all therapists".
beats.reassess: Her report is honest, and a larger random survey later can confirm the figure.

text.en: **Protect privacy.** Collect only what you need, keep surveys anonymous where possible, store data securely and do not publish small cells that could identify a person. If a question may reveal harm, such as abuse or self-harm, include information on where to get help.
text.ur: **Nijiyat mehfooz rakhein.** Sirf wohi jama karein jo chahiye, mumkin ho to survey gumnaam rakhein, data mehfooz rakhein aur chhote hissay shaya na karein jo kisi ki pehchan karwa sakein. Agar koi sawal nuqsan ka pata de sakta ho, jaise zyadati ya khud ko nuqsan, to madad kahan se milegi us ki maloomat shamil karein.

text.en: Kelley and colleagues reviewed good practice in survey research, covering clear aims, sampling, questionnaire design, piloting, response rates and reporting, and warned that results from low response or poor sampling cannot be generalised. The CHERRIES checklist asks authors of web surveys to report how participants were recruited, how the survey was designed and tested, the response rate and how data were protected.
text.ur: Kelley aur saathiyon ne survey research ki achhi practice ka jaiza liya, jis mein saaf maqasid, sampling, questionnaire design, pilot, response rate aur report shamil hain, aur khabardar kiya ke kam response ya kharab sampling ke nateeje generalise nahi ho sakte. CHERRIES checklist web surveys ke musannifon se kehti hai ke batayein shirkat karne wale kaise liye gaye, survey kaise design aur test hua, response rate kya tha aur data kaise mehfooz hua.

text.en: **Who, How, Who answered.** Who you asked, how you asked, and who actually answered.
text.ur: **Kis se, Kaise, Kis ne jawab diya.** Aap ne kis se poochha, kaise poochha, aur asal mein kis ne jawab diya.

summary.en: A survey is only as good as its sample, its questions and its response rate.
summary.ur: Survey utna hi achha hai jitna uska sample, uske sawal aur uski response rate.

summary.en: Write neutral, single-topic questions, pilot them and report the response rate honestly.
summary.ur: Ghair jaanibdaar, ek mauzu ke sawal likhein, pilot karein aur response rate imaandari se report karein.

summary.en: Size does not fix bias; protect privacy and offer a language the respondents use.
summary.ur: Size bias theek nahi karta; nijiyat mehfooz rakhein aur woh zubaan dein jo jawab dene wale istemal karte hain.

back.en: Results are skewed because those who answer differ from those who do not.
back.ur: Nateeje bigad jate hain kyunke jawab dene walay na dene walon se mukhtalif hote hain.

back.en: One whose wording pushes the respondent towards a particular answer.
back.ur: Jis ke alfaaz jawab dene wale ko khaas jawab ki taraf dhakelte hain.

back.en: To find confusing or badly worded items before sending it widely.
back.ur: Wasi pemane par bhejne se pehle uljhane wale ya ghalat alfaaz wale items dhoondhne ke liye.

front.en: Does a bigger sample fix bias?
front.ur: Kya bara sample bias theek karta hai?

back.en: No; size reduces random error, not bias.
back.ur: Nahi; size random ghalti kam karta hai, bias nahi.
